entries.learning_activity: (a) Compare things based on size, quality and quantity (e.g., big-bigger-biggest, much-more-most)

teaching_learning_activities: Descriptive passage: Guide the pupils through circling the prepositions in the passage
“Do As I Say” Game: Guide the pupils through using commands with prepositions to move into different positions
The List Challenger: Guide the pupils through creating sentences using the given prepositions
entries.assessment: Location is expressed using appropriate prepositions of direction

teaching_learning_activities: Dialogue: Prepare a dialogue using present perfect and past perfect tenses and let the pupils practice it

entries.assessment: Completed and unfinished actions are expressed correctly

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of basic English language skills
entries.specific_competence: 1.2 Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary both orally and in writing
entries.learning_activity: (e) Use conjunctions in oral and written contexts (target: too… to, either …or, neither…nor)
teaching_learning_activities: Songs: Play a song on conjunction (e.g., “Conjunction Junction” by School House Rock) and guide the pupils through using the song to discuss conjunctions
Describing: Write too… to, either… or and neither… nor on the board and guide the pupils through describing the usage of each of these pairs
Discussion: Guide the pupils through discussing the targeted conjunction and create pairs of simple sentences
entries.assessment: Conjunctions are used in oral and written contexts
entries.references: TET, English kwa Shule za Msingi Darasa la Tano: Kitabu cha Mwanafunzi na Kiongozi cha Mwalimu (Toleo la 2023), Taasisi ya Elimu Tanzania

entries.specific_competence: 1.2 Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary both orally and in writing
entries.learning_activity: (f) Use active and passive voices to communicate in different contexts
teaching_learning_activities: Active Approach: Guide the pupils through saying the actions after you show the action
Brainstorming: Guide the pupils through brainstorming about things that the government does for the people
Construction: Guide the pupils through using passive voice to report about things done in their communities
Transformation: Guide the pupils through reporting the same events in active voice and later changing them to passive voice
entries.assessment: Active and passive voices are used appropriately to communicate in different contexts
entries.references: TET, English kwa Shule za Msingi Darasa la Tano: Kitabu cha Mwanafunzi na Kiongozi cha Mwalimu (Toleo la 2023), Taasisi ya Elimu Tanzania

teaching_learning_activities: Tongue Twisters: Pronounce a tongue twister and ask the pupils to do the same

entries.learning_activity: (a) Create a journal to record inspiring things (at home, at school, from TV and radio programmes, etc.)

Vocabulary stories : Pupils construct a story and write it in their journals before reading it to other pupils
